title: Carousel Video Ads for Product Stories | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one product photo into a sequenced carousel video ad, then add your headline and price after download. Choose a format for feeds and product pages.
h1: Carousel Video Ad That Walks Through One Product
lead: Place one product photo in a scene, add an AI voice or a script, and keep the whole clip on that one product.
steps_h2: How to Make a Carousel Video Ad in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: The shots stay in the order you describe. Set the voice and the price in the editor.

steps.d: Upload one photo of the product shoppers will see on the product page. Keep the full item visible.
Describe the shots in order, add a short script, and pick 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. Keep every shot on that one item.
Download the file with no watermark, set the voice in the editor, and post it.

faq.q: What is a carousel video ad?
faq.a: One ordered clip about a single product, from an opening look to an in-use shot and a clear finish. It is a video, not a stack of still cards. An AI voice and a presenter can be added, and the person on screen is not a customer.

faq.q: How do I make a carousel video ad?
faq.a: Upload one product photo, describe the shots in order, add or edit a script, pick a size and a length, then download. You can also paste the product page link to draft the script and the presenter.

faq.q: What products can a carousel video ad show?
faq.a: One item per file: a bag, a bottle, a beauty product, apparel or electronics. Everyday fashion fits, and so does any product you can photograph. Put a second product in another file.

faq.q: Can I make more than one version?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the same photo and make another cut for a second audience, opening or language. Each file shows its credit cost before it runs.

faq.q: Who is a carousel video ad for?
faq.a: Fashion and electronics shops, and other stores that want an Instagram, Facebook, TikTok or product-page clip to walk through one item. You do not have to book a shoot.
Yes. You do not need editing experience. Upload the photo, adjust the script and the voice in the built-in editor, and download.

faq.q: Where can I post the file?
faq.a: On TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and your product page. Sizes include 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3 and 3:4. The download has no watermark.
24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15 and 120 for 30. You see the cost first. A failed job returns its credits. Plans start at $24.50 a month.
No. There is no free plan. Plans start at $24.50 a month, and the download has no watermark.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link or an API?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product page link to draft the scene, the script and the presenter, or send the photo through the API. Review the product in the file before you post.

faq.q: Can the voice be in another language?
faq.a: Yes. Make the same sequence with a voice in another language, and approve the words before you post.
